from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BorrowingCashData(BaseModel):
    """One company's cash received from borrowing for the reported period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label for borrowing cash received, as written in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount reported for borrowing cash received")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the amount, e.g., CNY, yuan")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this data")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    borrowing_cash_data: list[BorrowingCashData]
